items.description: Nike holt den Zegama ins ACG-Universum und damit dorthin, wo All Conditions Gear seit jeher zuhause ist: raues Gelände, lange Distanzen, kompromisslose Haltbarkeit. Der Nike ACG Zegama Trail baut auf der 2022 eingeführten Zegama-Linie auf, dem ersten Nike-Trailrunner mit ZoomX-Schaum, und gilt als bislang robustester Ableger der Reihe. Entwickelt wurde er mit Input von Trail-Athleten, die das Modell im Ultra-Terrain getestet haben. Die Ausführung Cream II / Light Orewood Brown / Black / Anthracite setzt auf gedeckte Erdtöne und ein Engineered-Mesh-Obermaterial mit nahtlosen Overlays. Ein elastischer Knöchelbund hält Steine und Geröll draußen. items.title: Handball Spezial
items.description: The adidas Handball Spezial in the Dusky Bronze / Off White / Gum4 colorway combines sporting heritage with timeless retro design and a particularly harmonious color combination. Originally developed for professional handball players in 1979, this legendary adidas classic has become one of the most popular silhouettes in modern sneaker fashion. The upper is crafted from soft cow suede in a warm, slightly reddish-brown shade, giving the shoe a distinctive yet refined appearance. The three signature adidas Stripes in creamy Off White create a striking contrast and perfectly complement the light-colored heel overlay. Gold-colored “SPEZIAL” lettering on the lateral side emphasizes the authentic vintage character while adding a subtle, premium detail. Brown laces and coordinating stitching complete the cohesive overall design. The classic T-shaped toe overlay and slim, low-profile silhouette preserve the unmistakable appearance of the original. Completing the look is a flexible natural gum rubber outsole in the Gum4 shade, featuring a slightly translucent, caramel-brown finish that further enhances the nostalgic aesthetic. Whether paired with jeans, chinos, or relaxed casual outfits, this adidas sneaker offers versatile styling possibilities while combining classic indoor sports heritage with contemporary everyday appeal. items.title: Nike Air Force 1 *Cracked Leather*
